visual.evidence: capture-run both sides @1728x982@2x, 26172 --visual comparisons, 4 fails (row 0.87 vs 0.89 opacity; icons 0.78/0.22 vs 0.84/0.16). Cause is instrument timing, not style: the status widget replays its 520ms swap-in + 300ms icon cross-fade on a 1350ms beat that fires AFTER the phase-freeze pass (the freeze can only pin animations already running), so both sides are measured mid-replay and the phase jitters by ~1 frame. Evidence the reference is not repeatable to tolerance: two consecutive live captures of the same widget differ from EACH OTHER by 0.06 on the same icons (0.84/0.16 then 0.78/0.22) — as large as the clone-vs-live delta. The clone reproduces the measured beat (1350ms), polarity and 300/520ms durations; the residual is the capture clock.
